bead.title: providers/llamaserver: nest enable_thinking inside chat_template_kwargs envelope
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-010 amendment (2026-05-11) §8'-9' requires llamaserver to send `enable_thinking` inside a `chat_template_kwargs` envelope, matching upstream llama.cpp expectations. Current code emits `enable_thinking` at the top level of the request body, which llama.cpp ignores.

ROOT CAUSE: internal/provider/llamaserver request-body builder (locate via `grep -rn 'enable_thinking' internal/provider/llamaserver`) sets `enable_thinking` as a sibling of model/messages instead of nesting it under `chat_template_kwargs`.

PROPOSED FIX: In the llamaserver request-body construction path, replace the top-level `enable_thinking` field with a `chat_template_kwargs` object whose `enable_thinking` member carries the boolean. Remove the obsolete top-level field. Add an assertion test `TestLlamaserver_EnableThinking_WireBody` that marshals a request with thinking enabled and asserts (a) `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking == true`, (b) no top-level `enable_thinking` key exists.

NON-SCOPE: ThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort enum addition (separate child); reasoning-token telemetry fallback (separate child); changes to llamaserver auth, streaming, or error mapping; refactors to shared request-body helpers beyond the minimal change.

Governing artifacts: ADR-010 amendment 2026-05-11 §8'-9'; AR-2026-05-17-repo; source review fizeau-8e37e536.

VERIFICATION: `go test ./internal/provider/llamaserver/... ./... -count=1` green; lefthook hooks pass.

AC:
1) llamaserver request body emits `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking`; no top-level `enable_thinking` key remains.
2) Test `TestLlamaserver_EnableThinking_WireBody` asserts both the presence of the nested key and absence of the top-level key.
3) Test `TestLlamaserver_EnableThinking_Disabled` asserts the envelope is omitted (or `enable_thinking:false` nested) when thinking is disabled, matching ADR-010 §9'.
4) `go test ./... -count=1` passes.
5) lefthook hooks pass.
bead.acceptance:
1) llamaserver request body nests enable_thinking inside chat_template_kwargs.
2) TestLlamaserver_EnableThinking_WireBody asserts nested-present and top-level-absent.
3) TestLlamaserver_EnableThinking_Disabled covers the disabled path per ADR-010 §9'.
4) go test ./... -count=1 green.
5) lefthook pre-commit and pre-push pass.
